entries.en: And yet, you seem less than pleased.
They should be. Aren't you?
Oh, all right. Good luck, Commander.
I've got to get going.
Last time I asked an officer he told me to stay out of it -- "for Jenna's safety".
Really? That's fantastic. Well, I hope that goes well.
Just tell me!
It's out of my hands, Rita. I'd bring her back in a second, but she doesn't want to come.
[sigh] I know. I know. I'll see if I can talk some sense into her next time I see her.
Be careful. You know how stubborn your sister can be. The more you push and prod, the more she'll run away.
Yeah, you're probably right. Thanks, Doran.
You ready to get the hell off this station, Commander?
Come see me when you're ready to do this. I'll be right here waiting for you.
Hopefully, he won't be there. If he is, I'll just have to think of something.
Udina won't let this slide, Captain. You'll be charged with treason, a capital offense.
The ambassador will not forgive this, Captain. You will be charged with treason, a capital offense.
The ambassador won't forgive this, Captain. You'll be charged with treason, a capital offense.
We don't have a lot of options. I break into the ambassador's computer, or I take my chances with the patrols in Citadel control.
I was hoping you'd say that. The ambassador has made this personal.
I'll break into the ambassador's office. He made this personal.
I'll take care of the lockdown. You get down to the Normandy and tell Joker to stand by.
I'm glad you came, Shepard. I heard what happened.
I know. I'm sorry. I wanted to warn you, but there was no way to get a message to you before you docked.
I tried. The ambassador wouldn't let me get a message through before you docked.
I know you're pissed off right now, but you can't give up. They all think this is over, but we both know it's not.
You have to go to Ilos. You have to stop Saren from using the Conduit!
Citadel control's locked out all the Normandy's systems. But if we override the ambassador's orders we can get them to bring the Normandy back on-line.
You can be in the Terminus Systems before anyone even knows you're gone.
And if Saren finds the Conduit, life as we know it is over. The Reapers will destroy us. Humans, asari, everybody!
You're the only one who can stop him, Shepard. So I'll do whatever it takes to get you on the Normandy and off this station.
The Normandy's your ship now, Commander. Her crew will follow you to the ends of the galaxy. We both know that.
I can unlock the Normandy from one of the consoles in the Citadel control center. You'll have a few minutes before anyone realizes what's happened.
That's a restricted area patrolled by armed guards. How are you going to get in?
That is a restricted area patrolled by armed guards. How are you going to get in?
Leave that to me. Just make sure you're in the Normandy when the systems come back on-line.
Ambassador Udina issued the lockdown order. If I can hack into the computer in his office, maybe I can override it.
He's not going to let you waltz into his office and use his computer.
He's not gonna let you waltz into his office and use his computer.
He won't just stand by while you use his computer.
He will not just stand by while you use his computer.
I still have some things to take care of.
They pulled me off the mission. Just like when they forced you to give up the Normandy.
The Normandy's been grounded.
You had to know what was going to happen. Why didn't you warn me?
There's only one ship that can get me into the Terminus Systems undetected, and she's grounded.
If we steal the Normandy, you're the one left holding the bag.
Stealing the Normandy is mutiny. What if the crew won't help me?
I won't forget this, Captain. I promise.
What's the plan?
You're going to get yourself killed. There has to be another way.
There's got to be a better way.
You'll have a better chance if you go after the ambassador's computer.
It's your call, Captain.
If you're lucky, the patrols won't catch you.
Now I know how you felt.
Udina sold me out.
You could've helped me!
What happens to you?
Tell me what to do.
What about my crew?
It's too dangerous.
I don't like it.
Any other options?
Break into his office.
You decide.
Citadel control.
I believe this machine has been tampered with, and someone is funneling credits to a private account. I will attempt to trace the signal.
I think somebody rigged this machine to funnel credits through the system. Let me trace the signal.
Someone rigged this machine to funnel credits their way. I'll run a trace.
Someone rigged this machine to funnel credits their way.  I'll trace it.
I need to speak with you a moment.
You've got the same device Schells had earlier. Did he give it to you, or did you take it from him?
Never mind. It doesn't matter how you got it. But I can't let you keep it.
Don't make a scene, Commander.
Now, I suggest you stick to playing the game fairly, or not at all.
Your luck seems... unnatural, human.
Don't often see someone getting as lucky as you.
I don't think you're going to take it from me.
I'm not hurting anyone.
What device?
I've already recovered the credits you won.
Anybody got a spare credit? Credits for a vet?
Hey, what's your story, buddy?
Anybody got tram fare? I have to get to another ward.
I've only got 20. Think that's enough for whisky?
Think I'm starting to get the shakes.
Hey. Hey! You're the Shepard kid!
C'mon, just talk to me a minute!
You don't remember me, do you?
Hey, back again, eh? Don't suppose you got any credits to spare?
Did she? I wonder.
What's to talk about, kid?
Why? You think you've got something profound to say about it?
People tied like prize hogs. Locked in cages, clawing and screaming as they're loaded into cargo pods.
And we couldn't reach them. The batarian defenses had us pinned. Dozens died trying to advance. All we could do was watch as they hauled people away.
I've been looking for 13 years for something to make that sight go away. What have you got? Huh?
What? You think I drink because I like lying in the gutter?
If you don't have a better option, just give me 20 credits. A good bottle of whisky. Enough to stop the dreams.
Great. Sixty meals of ramen.
All right. Thanks. You're trying to help. I guess.
Tell your mom I said hi, okay?
The VAO--? God. If she wants me to go talk to someone, fine. I'll do it. For her. She always stuck up for me.
Heh. She always was naive. All the VAO does is pump you full of chemicals.
Yeah. Thanks for the help.
You don't want to help, fine. I'll go to the damn VAO. Got nothing else to do but talk about my "feelings."
You've got a smart mouth, kid. Funny how your mom never mentioned that.
If she wants to talk, tell her she can reach me through the Citadel VAO.
Damn right it is.
Yeah, right. So we all have it tough, huh? I get what you're saying.
Don't worry about me, kid. I won't bother you again. Tell your mom I said hi.
No batarians come here, you know? That's good. Good.
You ever just sit and watch people? You can learn a lot.
Thanks for the credits, kid.
I'll be fine. Don't worry about me.
Hey. Been a long time, huh?
No, no. I knew your parents, kid!
I guess you don't remember me. Lieutenant Zabaleta? I worked with your mother.
We served on the carrier Einstein. That was 12, 13 years back. You were just a kid then.
"Retired," yeah. You know how it is. Times are tough for vets. They always are.
Hey, call your mom up and ask. She'd remember old Zabaleta. She'd vouch for me.
Listen. I need a favor. I'm kind of short on money these days. I hate hitting you up for money, but a man's gotta eat, right?
So, uh, could you spare something? Maybe 20 credits?
Hey, you're a good kid, you know that? Thanks.
Nah, nah. I'll just get a-- a meal. You know.
I'm not a bad guy, kid. Just took my share of lumps. Don't judge me.
Yeah, that's okay. I get it.
You ever want to come by and talk, I'll be here. Heh. Can't afford a ticket home, right?
I spoke to my mother. She told me about what happened on Mindoir.
Already hitting me up for money? I came here to talk about Mindoir.
I heard you were at Mindoir. I wanted to talk about what you saw.
I'm not going to give you money to drink yourself to death. You need to stop this.
Right. Because forgetting is much easier than dealing with it.
I can't help you if you don't want to be helped. Do you really want to get over what you saw?
I'm not going to give you money to blow on booze. I'll give you a line of credit at a grocery store.
My mother said to go to the Veteran's Affairs Office. You're not the only one who's seen that brand of hell. They can help.
Like I'm going to waste good money on you.
You want to play the martyr, whine to the other bums. You want to get better, try the Veteran's Office. We've got seven million vets. Someone else has been through this.
If booze is all you want, fine. It's your choice.
Would if I could, but I'm between paydays myself.
I'm sorry. Do we know each other?
Someone else who "knows" me now that I'm famous. We go to kindergarten together or something?
I didn't see her much that tour. The ship was on patrol most of the time.
I guess you're not in the service anymore, huh?
And you expect me to just take your word for that?
Sorry, I don't remember you.
Yeah, it's not a problem.
Twenty isn't enough to get you back on your feet, is it?
You're barking up the wrong Shepard. Maybe my mother would help you. I think you'll just blow it on booze.
Sorry, I don't have that much right now.
You did know my mother.
